test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A shopkeeper offered successive discounts of 10% and 15% on an article having a marked price of Rs. 28,000. Find the selling price of the article.
solution:
**Given:**

Marked Price (MP) = Rs. 28,000

Successive Discounts = 10% and 15%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price (SP) = MP × (1 - d₁/100) × (1 - d₂/100)

**Calculation:**

First Discount = 10%

Second Discount = 15%

Marked Price (MP) = Rs. 28,000

First Selling Price (SP₁) = MP × (1 - 10/100)

⇒ SP₁ = 28,000 × 0.90

⇒ SP₁ = 25,200

Final Selling Price (SPfᵢₙₐₗ) = SP₁ × (1 - 15/100)

⇒ SPfᵢₙₐₗ = 25,200 × 0.85

⇒ SPfᵢₙₐₗ = 21,420

**The selling price of the article is Rs. 21,420.**
